description: DefiLlama provides free public APIs for DeFi TVL, yields, fees, bridges, stablecoins, coins, and protocol analytics across chains.
resolution_notes: base_url: CONFIRMED original value https://api.llama.fi is the primary documented base URL for TVL/core endpoints (docs: https://defillama.com/docs/api). Verifier A noted additional product-specific hosts (coins.llama.fi, stablecoins.llama.fi, yields.llama.fi, bridges.llama.fi) but correctly stated the primary base remains api.llama.fi. Bare root 404 is expected (no index route) and does not indicate a dead API. Verifier B confirmed. Automated 404 on root and docs 403 are not evidence of incorrect base_url.
